science.title: A tiny squeeze dramatically changes the magnetism of exotic materials
science.summary: Scientists have discovered that a simple mechanical squeeze can dramatically alter the magnetic properties and electrical behavior of exotic materials called altermagnets. The surprising breakthrough could open the door to faster, more energy-efficient electronics and new technologies for quantum computing.

science.title: Cosmic hydrogen measurement marks breakthrough in mapping the universe
science.summary: An international research project is bringing scientists closer to mapping the universe. The MeerKLASS Collaboration has reported its first measurement of the large-scale clustering of cosmic hydrogen, advancing a technique that could transform how cosmologists chart the universe.

science.title: Scientists reverse liver cell aging and cut Alzheimer’s-linked protein in half
science.summary: A surprising discovery suggests that rejuvenating the liver could help protect against Alzheimer’s disease and heart disease. USC researchers found that an experimental drug restored aging liver cells in rats, cutting levels of an Alzheimer’s-linked protein in half and bringing bad cholesterol down to youthful levels.

astronomy.title: Giant Impacts Help Rocky Planets Retain Their Atmospheres
astronomy.summary: For a long time, planetary scientists thought that giant impacts drove a young planet's atmosphere away into space with all the heat they generated. But it turns out the opposite could be true. The mass a young planet gains through a giant impact increases its gravitational hold on its atmosphere.
